name: yuan-dao
description: 闻道 MindSpeak 英语学习软件（Web + PWA + Android + 桌面版）

scripts.desktop:build: npm run build && npm run desktop:pack && tauri build
scripts.android:build: npm run build && npx cap sync android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/fix-java17.ps1 && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run build && npx cap sync android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/fix-java17.ps1 && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleRelease
